text: Nice place and setting, food is very tasty and good portions. Although not very authentic, adopted to majority of the people

I was looking for a local bar to have some drinks with my beau. Went to yelp and found DuBa's and I was immediately intrigued. Such a cool, unique karaoke bar right in Elkins Park. I got the adult Capri-Sun and honey garlic wings. Both were amazing. My boyfriend had a beer and the drunken noodles which were really good as well. Nice crowd,  pleasant atmosphere, free yummy popcorn, and the bartender was on point. Service for food however was a bit slow and we had to flag down a waiter to take our order. Food came out piping hot. We didn't do karaoke and didn't see anyone partaking while we were there. I will definitely come back with the girls for some karaoke fun. A great night.

Ordered at 6:10 pizza came at 7:30 ice cold had to put it in the oven to heat it up. Horrible experience. I will never order from Wolf Street Pizza again. Promise. Worst part about it is I live 2 blocks away on the 2200 block of Woodstock Street. Gabe P. from South Philly.

I came here on a whim for one of my coworker's birthday. First time here and honestly not bad. Our server, Quynh was so nice and accommodating to our needs. When one of our stoves was not working, they fixed it right away. The food was great and for a reasonable price. Totally recommend!

The restaurant is immaculate and very well kept. The service was great. I'm sure they have other wonderful  options here for food- the reviews all say so. 

This is just not a sushi restaurant.
Staff was very friendly, clean place following safety measures and everything we ordered was really good!!!
Good fresh food that is made to order so sometimes it might be a little slow but that's ok.  I love their coffee.  Good price and excellent service.

I tried the catfish, shrimp and fried chicken wings dinner and it was fantastic. All the food was seasoned great. The draw back was that the sides were small in quantity but good in quality. The rice and beans can in a separate cup that wasn't very large. The Mac and cheese was really good as well. I would certainly good back and eat the food. I heard the dessert is phenomenal so I have to try it next time.

Todo está muy rico y fresco el bistec está riquísimo los tacos esto si es comida mexicana muy limpio y una excelente atención Mmmmm el burrito de bistec todo lo que preparan esta fresco del día y sus aguas frescas sabrosas

Excellent fresh food! Dennis is always so friendly and polite. Lovely outside seating. And the Raspberry ice tea is so good! I think I have tried almost everything on the menu and have loved it all. We usually eat here at least once a week.

We love Don Juan! This was our first time dining inside [during the pandemic], but we have picked up tacos on Taco Tuesdays before.

My boyfriend got a jarrito and I got the horchata, which was delicious and nice to have something creamy and sweet with dinner. They always seem to have a drink special going on, this time it was $1 off margaritas but passed on the alcohol this time.

I was in between a lot of options, so I decided to get a few apps to build a meal. My first time having sope, I chose the carnita as my meat - the cup is a soft corn shell filled with the meat (tender and juicy) and toppings. I would definitely get this again. The ceviche was refreshing and tangy. And lastly, the elote was charred beautifully. My boyfriend got the torta, and I of course stole a bite. The bread was toasty and great, and to quote him "every bite was a bite well spent, good ratio of bread and filling."

Service was great and Juan stopped by our table to see how everything was. Thank you!

It pains me to leave two stars for this place because the employees are all so friendly.  But I've gone here twice now and both times there have been some major issues with the food.  First time, I ordered salmon with roasted brussel sprouts.  It was a tiny portion - surely not enough for anyone with any appetite at all to get full.  But even worse, the salmon and brussels were extremely salty, and this is coming from someone who truly enjoys salty food.  This was a take out order and so there was nothing to be done about ordering something else, but I did contact the manager by phone to let her know about the extreme saltiness.  She was quite friendly, assured me that they would adjust based on my feedback, and took steps to make it right.

I was so impressed with the customer service and employees that I decided to give the place a second chance, bringing my wife along this time.  Again, I ordered the salmon and brussels (My choices are limited because of some dietary restrictions).  This time, I told the pleasant young lady taking my order to please make sure that it is not salty.  She alerted the kitchen staff immediately.  Again, my order comes out, and it is incredibly salty plus the same small portion!  

By the way, aside from the extreme saltiness, the food actually tastes quite good.  The brussels in particular developed a lovely flavor through the no rush oven roasting and the salmon was not overcooked.  My wife ordered some bbq chicken with fries - she was general

The squeeze Is amazing. We had the best breakfast and even better service. We want to give a huge shout out to Ian.  He made sure we were taken care of throughout the whole squeeze in experience. Also having the option to do a waitlist on Yelp was so helpful. We will definitely stop here every time  we come to Reno. Thanks again to the squeeze in crew.

I been to Vons chicken in Santa Clara and I have to say it tasted exactly like it. It's nice that there is a Korean chicken place to go to. I like the chicken here since it always taste much lighter then going to like a kfc or Popeyes .

This is a pretty cool place. It is really big with plenty of seating both inside and outside in the beer garden. The beers are very tasty and they have a very good selection. The food is great too. I had the Chipotle burger which had awesome flavor and the fries were actually cooked right. Great service, plenty to do, and extra spacious. Will definitely return. Look forward to seeing the beer garden upgrades that are currently under construction.
Friendly people and delicious food! The pickup process is always fast and easy. My favorite vegan order: Mongolian tofu and Lemon tofu. I live pretty far out, but it's always worth the drive!

So I would have taken a pic, but I ate my food so fast I didn't get a chance too . I ordered for the first time yesterday. Got fried jumbo shrimp, Mac and cheese and greens. My food was absolutely delicious. I'm actually going to order again today so my son can try it. I definitely recommend these guys!
Came in for my dads birthday! Peter and staff awesome service. Family oriented and great service

My husband and I love coming here! Sabrina makes the most creative and fresh dishes. Super fun atmosphere, great music. Also lots of vegetarian and gluten free options. Different daily specials. 5 stars!!

Updates 18-Oct-2020
After a horrible experience below the owner reached out to me the next day.  This was very appreciated.

Tonight we ordered, arrived and our food was ready within 5 minutes or estimated time.  No it wasn't because they knew the name I had my son place the order to ensure this.

Very friendly staff brought food out based on car color, make, and time.

I changed the review from 1 back to 5 stars.
Food was delicious!!!!


OLD REVIEW:  Had a horrible experience tonight.
Ordered dinner online and arrived about 5 minutes early for pickup.  Guy running the pickup outside told me to go park and he would bring when it was ready. 30 minutes later I walked over (they were very busy so assumed they were behind) to get status, once he finished texting he said "oh I totally forgot to bring it over" and handed me a bag of cold food.  

I asked for the manager and she was about as helpful and understanding as the limp fries in my bag.  All I got out if her was "un huh, ok, un huh, i can give you a cookie". REALLY? so $40+ food is cold but a cookie will make it all better?!?!?! 

She is going to "talk" to the guy about it
And said she will tell the owner I was unhappy.  

I know absolutely no one from CR Heroes will read this or even care about the service their staff and manager gave but I felt it needed to be said. 

Right now restaurants should be happy to have the customers but it seems they couldn't care less about the service.

We recently ate at this gastropub and found their food and service excellent.
They have a limited menu, as is typical of gastropubs, but they put out excellent dishes.  Service is also top notch.
My wife and I tried two different hamburgers, the Union burger (basically a cheese burger), and the Mushroom Melt burger.  Both were excellent.  The ingredients in their dishes were of high quality, the burgers were massive, juicy, and very tasty.  They were cooked just right.  They were served on a fresh brioche bun which was also delicious.
Would definitely recommend them if you are looking for a top notch burger and great service.
The best Vietnamese food in all Santa Barbara!! Friendly staff. Reasonable prices. Open for takeouts. Go support our local restaurants!!

They seem to have a new manager on the patio. She does a great job. She keeps a close eye on the tables and gets everyone seated as quickly as possible. If you haven't been in a while, it's worth going back.

I have been eating here for a while and it is always an absolute pleasure. The oysters are fabulous and the service is speedy.

Highest recommendations!
Great food! Great service! Great atmosphere! First time and definitely will be our new spot to stop on the way home from Valley Green

Great service with tasty fresh foods are always a winning combination.
Careful if you're gluten free as all of the spicy rolls have tempura in them..

7/31/19- review update
Just stopped in for a quick lunch that ended up taking way over an hour. We ordered some sushi from the all you can eat menu and totally our fault for not telling the waitress (who we interrupted in the middle of her lunch) that my husband cannot have tampura crunch so they made all of the sushi with crunch. When it came, we apologized and asked to send it back. Instead of making us new sushi they didn't make anything for a while and when we asked if they can make it it was taking forever. We had paid and asked if we can take the food which they were already preparing with us to which they said no... what a waste of food and time.
If only someone spoke English in that place it might have worked out better for explaining the gluten free situation.
Yeah.. sadly we will never return.

UGH..... this is the nicest term that comes to mind at this moment.  

I feel like this place once had some time in the lime light.  But it has since gone downhill.  Quality of food was poor.  Decor was old, dusty, and very outdated.  Owner and wife spent several hours in the corner of the bar drinking many bottles of beer and eating "gooey butter cake".  

I do NOT recommend:
-"French onion soup" - I sent it back and asked for the cheese to actually be melted.... was told "Swiss doesn't melt".  SEE PHOTO
-Wings -  Most of the wings had broken legs.  Hard to eat with all those chipped shards hidden inside.  Also, St Louis does not do bleu cheese... so you're stuck with ranch
-Fried Ravioli - Tasteless, yet they were meat filled.  Cheap, frozen food made in mass quantities for sure.  
-Bathrooms  -  Make sure you check out the 26+ step you have to take upstairs to the old nasty bathroom!  Aahh!!


I do recommend:
-Bottle beer so you don't drink from anything contaminated or dirty
-Gooey butter cake

Been twice, probably won't return. The service is great but I'm just not blown away by the food. The fries weren't good, overdone and cold. All the ranch  flavors we tried were runny too. I think it's one of those places you have to check out for yourself though.
We live the  hot catfish! We keep coming back just for that! The hot chicken is good as well. Good Mac n cheese and potato salad too!

Went to Fellini with a group of friends to celebrate birthdays and we had a great experience. Highly recommend. Service was excellent. Everyone's food was amazing. Cannolis and cappuccino were a great way to end the meal. Five star experience. Will definitely be back. Thanks!!
Good food fast service reasonably  priced. The menu has large selection  of different  types  of Asian food. The staff was friendly  and willing  to assure you order is correct.

Absolutely delicious! We were immediately  seated and our drink orders were taken.  We quickly received bread, which was delicious. The pizza was excellent! We ordered the Margarita and Milano pizza. Very flavorful- this was our first time, but most definitely not our last.

I almost don't want to leave this review so as to keep it a secret but this place might be one of the biggest hidden gems in Philly and near center city. Cheap prices like you're in the suburbs but still awesome food and a good beer selection. Server was cool and impressive remembering 4 people's orders straight from memory and reciting it back to us to double check. This place is the bomb.

We love this place for the atmosphere and great service. The food is always great and we have never had a bad meal.  Our only question is their pricing for margaritas... we always order the same margarita everywhere we go. Top shelf ( don julio, patron, casa amigos etc...) rocks, salt... done. Here they offer the Grand Ma float which we never turn down. We have been charged anywhere from 19.5 to 23.00 for 1 top shelf margarita!!  We have never brought this up as we always assume it's an error on the bartender and oh well. But I think that it's there pricing now that it's been 4-5 times.  We have drank top shelf margaritas at the best resorts in the country never costing more than $12-15 .... at a resort!  This is a joke!  They are charging $14.00 just for the patron per marg....then more for the mix which isn't great... and more for the grand ma. $14.00 per shot for patron?????  Patron is not worth that.... and not many top shelf margaritas are ever worth $19-23, ever!  Cmon guys, figure it out.
When it comes to breakfast by the Gretna courthouse, it is the only game in town. It isn't too bad for the West Bank.
The quality of food is always great. We frequently visit this location. Never disappointed. Recommend

Love coming here, but it makes me feel like a tourist. But other than that, there's so much of a variety. and there's also a mini farmers market to get fresh veggies and fruit. there's always something new to try but the con is there rarely anywhere to sit and don't go on a weekend. you'll get too annoyed with how crowded it is, where you barely have room to walk

My husband and I ordered two large beverages. One was a lychee tea with no add ons, and a Thai milk tea with almond milk instead. The lychee tea was amazing!! Nice and sweet and aromatic. The Thai tea was also very good. The two ladies working were very nice and patient. Good prices and in a great location. A must try if you are curious about different exotic teas. They also have pastries.

I am so sad that Southcreek has had to cease operation today.   I was getting ready to order my favorite pizza only to find out they needed to close.   The ownership and staff at Southcreek are the best and I am worried about each of them.   
From the Ribs and Pizza to the Zinfandel I always enjoy we are waiting for your reopening.   These are tragic times for restaurants and once they reopen we need to make sure we support them. Please keep us informed on your re-opening !

Second time there.  Also last time...
Free chips good; salsa more like ketchup. Out of chile rilleno. Retried beans have the consistency of baby food with no trace of beans.  Although the "special dinner" had three distinct items, they all had the same bland cheese sauce. Hard to get the check.

The combination of words known as "collard green melt" would normally make my butthole pucker up in anti-vegetarianism protestation but in Turkey and the Wolf's case, that sandwich is a goddamn religion. 

That is all.

I never wrote a review. This is my first one. Unfortunately on Mother's Day I was treated with the scallops and steak hibachi. BEWARE, there was mold on top of my sauce container which was enclosed with the food we order from take out. I'm sad to say, I will NEVER return here to eat. Cleanliness should be a top priority! I was disgusted. I regret not taking a picture of the sauce but I was so disgusted I threw out the whole platter out of disgust! Mold absolutely disgusts me and to pay for moldy food, you should be ashamed of yourselves!
If you used to frequent Chickies deli (same location) this is the place to go! Excellent hoagies and service. The prices are decent too. Nicely done.

I'm really disappointed.  I was in yesterday - got two coffees and a whole butter ring.  The ordering was a total fiasco - I had to tell the guy at the counter 4 times that I wanted the whole ring. I get it, it was a crazy day.  Then he described it as custard but it's marzipan.  That's a whopping big difference.  Darn good thing we're not allergic to tree nuts. Zero mention of this potentially life-threatening allergen (not to mention we just don't care for marzipan and wouldn't have bought it had we known). We've always enjoyed our visits when we're in SB - I'm going to assume it was an off day and we will go back. But get it together folks.
I ordered fish taco and it was delicious and I like this place very much. Waitress was super friendly
Hands down the best donuts in Tucson!  Let's not forget, they have the best price on a dozen of donuts, at just $8.50.  They're all delicious, from the yeast ones, the cakes ones, to the filled ones!

Solid bbq. Really good mac and cheese. The fries are so-so. Recommend the sweet potato. Their desserts are good as well if that's your thing.

There's plenty of choices of BBQ in Brandon, but this one is the closest to my house and they even deliver. Prices are fair will run you around $8-12 for a combo. 

Sauces are pretty good too.

Bricktops is consistently great every single time I'm here the sushi the chicken in the salads and the crabcakes are just a few of my favorites but every single thing on the menu is without a doubt some of the best food I've ever had. The service is impeccable whether you're sitting at the bar or in the main dining area. I just took my parents here last weekend from out of town and they couldn't stop talking about how great their experience was.
The food was on time and it was great. I loved the drunken noodles and Thai iced tea.
Food is great and servings are generous. I got 2 rice platters and my wife and I are completely satisfied. Will be coming back
I just had shake shack for the first time day and I went to this location my burger and cheese fries were good I was shocked can't wait to go back and try there Milkshakes

The staff is young and rude. Attitude of entitlement! I hate this location of Institution in Santa Barbara. Check out the one in Camarillo you'll like that location better you can even play boards games there!! When you have bad customer service your more likely to tell 10ppl versus when you have great experience you'd tell 5ppl. Very disappointed!

My wife and I wanted a quick dinner, so we headed to Dickey's.

Here is what I liked, the Chicken and Pulled Pork were delicious and on point.  The Cole slaw and barbecue beans were good, but beware if you think your getting Sonny's baked beans.  These are different, they are made with Pinto beans in a sauce that has some nice flavors.  I added the barbecue sauce to add some pop!

What I don't like is the portion size for the price.  

Overall, it was a good experience with friendly staff.

Amazing food. Very different from what we have tried at other Ethiopian restaurants, which was a fun change! The service is top notch. They even made my husband some gluten free injera. Will definitely be coming regularly!
Potato bacon soup is delicious! If you prefer mom and pop home cooking with a great cozy ambience. Welcoming and friendly staff make every patron feel like a regular. Definitely will come back again!

The most I like about the Grand Buffet have varieties asian, medeterian, taco bar,  seafood, plenty of dessert, fruits, ice cream. The interior  is new and clean,  the hotel is doing some construction  right now close by the buffet area  but not a big deal because service was great and quality food not too oil, freeze - dry like some restaurants. I'm totally full and satisfied.

I wish I could give this place zero stars. I am visiting Nashville and wanted to place an order around 7pm. A salad and two pizzas. Nothing crazy. I have been in the service industry as a waitress and now as a nurse. But the way we were treated was not okay. 

When I initially called, I was asked if it was delivery and take out. I heard laughing then I was just hung up on. Called again and was immediately hung up on again. It wasn't until the fourth time I called that I got someone to take me seriously... or so I thought.  For ordering a salad and pizza. It took so long and they didn't even have the order correct!! I said that we wanted to retract our order. We did not feel confident that the food would arrive correctly, on time, or arrive at all! 

Then, they had the audacity to text me on the phone that I had called on. Correcting me. The most unprofessional place I have ever dealt with. For a pizza delivery. I get that some people are new and everyone has to start somewhere. But just explain that on the phone. The manager should be understanding, not attacking people via text. It got to the point where I had to block the number. Unprofessional doesn't even touch it.

Very good Mediterranean spot. Good portions, prices and service. Got the veggie platter which basically had the entire menu and was perfect portions to share (2 of us).

The baba ganoush is probably my favorite portion of the meal and version I've had. It's smoky but not too smoky. I find sometimes it goes overboard with the smoky flavor and that wasn't here. It still had lots of flavor but good balance. 

The service was very sweet. She threw in an extra pita for us to split evenly (normally it's 3 pitas) and even made extra pineapple lemonade for us to have. 

Definitely would come back here!

I ordered a $5 pepperoni pizza half no cheese, they charged me over $7 for it saying it was a custom pizza. It's the same damn pizza they would have to make just less ingredients...total bullshit. less cheese more money???? Who does that...Little Caesars that's who!
This place is disgusting! I ordered vegetable fried rice and the rice was old and crusty. I will never eat here again!

We stopped in here for an early dinner last Friday. The waitress was very attentive and the food was great. I ordered the tuna salad with my tuna cooked medium-rare. When the salad came out and I cut into my tuna, it was cooked well done. We informed the waitress and she apologized immensely and took it back to be corrected. My parents ordered the special pizza and the house salad. The salad was huge, definitely enough to share! Overall it was a great dinner and everyone enjoyed their food.

Really good STL Italian food right by the airport! The bread, salad, chicken Gorgonzola were all amazing! I can't give 5 stars because the flash fried spinach wasn't fully done and there was some
Soggy bites that was gross but everything else was great!

Good food but a bit pricey.  My wife had #2 combo for $14.85.  I had the Carnitas at $17.85. It was ok but no 10.  I'm used to 50% more food for $12.95 and more flavor.  The only bargain was the 32oz Modelo Negro at $9.25.  We went in tonight (Friday) at 6:30pm and was seated quickly.  Service was great and courteous.   I would go back but not for the carnitas.  Parking was not great and limited handicapped spaces. Like most parking lots, great if you own a small car, hell if you have a big truck or SUV.

I visited Tino's recently for a business lunch meeting and also because Tino's is close to my personal residence. The counter service was friendly. We used a coupon during our visit and ordered a pizza with salami and extra cheese, along with two sodas. The restaurant interior is modest, relatively small, and not terribly bright and inviting. A renovation and redesign would do the place justice. As for the pizza, the sauce was applied generously and had a good flavor. The pizza crust was very average and, overall, the pizza did not have any exceptional qualities that made it stand out as a "Wow, I need to order this again!" Pizza. It's easy to make an average pizza, but more focus on the ingredients used could certainly elevate this pizza. 

With this said, I need to try some of their specialty pizzas and need to explore the entire menu more fully. A restaurant does not live or die by one menu item, so more pizzas will be eaten there!

We wanted to support the Toups' to show love for everything they have done for the city.  The ambiance was great and the music was even better.  Service was very good.  We were disappointed they were out of some things, therefore we couldn't order the drinks we wanted but we definitely understood.  We just had them make surprise drinks.  
The reason for the 4 stars is that the menu didn't have a lot to choose from.  However, everything we had was excellent.  I would like to see them show their talent in more variety on the menu.

We went to the Damonte ranch location and were not impressed with the food or service. We've eaten at the boomtown casino location and found the food and service much better. We live closer to the Damonte ranch location but we will  bypass that location for the boomtown casino location.

This is a hidden little breakfast spot I go to a few times a year when I'm in the area. Always have great gravy and biscuits and their corn beef hash is the best. The service was a little slow 3-4 years ago but things have picked up with new waitresses and the owner being very attentive.
Love that you can grab a burger, walk to tower grove park and have a picnic. The Belgium burger or the Dam Burger are my favorites. My son loves the hot dog and fries kids meal.

Absolutely amazing. Everything on the menu is awesome. I love love love butterfly pea tea!!!!! The tofu spring rolls and especially their sauce was beyond delicious! The taro jackfruit dumplings were so tasty too and their color is sooo purple in real life. Yes I order food based largely off appearance but this is one time the taste definitely surpassed the appearance even tho they were cute little dumplings
The best roast pork from here to Miami. Truly done right! I just hope that they made it through all this. Called and the line goes to busy. Suggestions roast pork yuca and macaroni salad!

If you're looking for great food with a flare and a beautiful relaxed ambiance of the cocktail lounge, Blooming Grove Inn is the place.  The bartenders, especially Noah, will make your cocktail to perfection.  The restaurant is beautiful old historic home nestled in a wooded area of Ewing township.   Visit and enjoy.

Everything sounds so good on paper. Unfortunately nothing we tried lived up to the hype. It almost tried too hard. The pizza was flabby and the other dishes we tried just completely fell flat flavor wise. We will be sticking to Christino's in the future.
Great food and great service. I had the crab cake and added on clam strips. I enjoyed it and it filled me up. Great location. Check them out!

Yikes! Made reservations for Friday night earlier today. When I called to add someone to our reservation to make it 5 people tonight, I was told they only accommodate 4 person tables-- and the earliest open table was 8:15 pm. Guess I have to book a table three weeks in advance... in Boise. Give me a break!
I absolutely love their pizza. My husband and undiscovered them by accident, and now we try to stop whenever we drive through Nashville. It's perfect for carryout, and it also repeats just as good.

Absolutely the worst place I have been to in the tri- state area. All staff was incredibly rude and not understanding in anyway shape or form.  They are incredibly strict with rules for covid, which I respect and appreciate, yet their staff was not even wearing mask above their nose. ALSO, did not follow the law of having to order food in order to get drinks. Yet, we are not allowed to take any photos by the water with masks on?Being here absolutely ruined mine and 12 other friend's night. Once we arrived, we could not even leave since there is a charge of reservations. Would definitely not recommend and will NEVER be back here.

I really hope the pandemic doesn't take away this business - because WOW! I was impressed. Such a great atmosphere in the restaurant. What it looks like on the outside is not what you would expect it to look like on the inside. The food was flavorful, tasty, and authentic. A really unique place that I recommend dining at.
Went for the night life and had the time of my life! DJ played great music and the crowd was definitely vibin. Didn't try the food but the drinks were great!

One tomato, two tomato benedict was AH-MAZING!!!! We had the best experience at this place! From the minute we walked in there, to the minute we left, we felt so welcomed and at home! I recommend this to anyone, especially us Cajuns!
Just want to reiterate. This place is great. After 4 years in Los Angeles, I still have found Indian food I enjoy as much as here.

I will describe this place as a Greek bakery / cafe
serving a modern take on Greek food and desserts.
They are open from 7am until 3pm weekdays and
8am until 3pm weekends. The place is a free
standing converted home with both indoor and
covered outdoor seating.
The word Psomi is a type of Greek bread. This
name is appropriate because they bake many
types of bread right on premises. They also
bake all their delicious pastries, danish and bagels.
The bakery is a free standing building behind
the restaurant with a window for guests to watch.
We tried their spanakopita which is made a little
different from the usual shape. It was excellent.
We shared a cold eggplant dip, melitzosalada, which came with pita chips.
My wife and I had a egg dish, strapatsada, as we were there for Mother's Day brunch. They also serve an egg Benedict dish made with bacon or salmon.
We took home desert which was traditional
Baklava, a baklava coffee cake, and a custard filled
tart.           
While all were good, the coffee cake was beyond excellent!  It is a large piece and can be shared by two. 
The service was excellent. 
They have there own off street parking.

I agree that this place may not appear 5 star but the staff was so friendly and the food was fabulous.  We were working a couple of blocks away and needed something quick and convenient.  We ended up eating there again for lunch a couple of days later.  We had ordered through Grubhub and the jack wagon that delivered our food forgot a bag and was nowhere to be found.  The restaurant promptly stepped up and brought the rest of our order to us.  Wonderful service!

Really looking forward to being a regular here once they iron out the kinks. I love ramen, I normally will drive 15-25 minutes to get some when the craving strikes, and this place is much closer to me. When you walk in, you can order crepes at the counter or sit to be served ramen. We ordered the most popular ramen and pork buns. The flavor of the pork buns were good, but it is served in a taco-like presentation. Not a true bun. 
Our server didn't know a lot about the menu, which as a former server I know is a management issue. When you have a new business, and a new employee, they should taste the menu. But the one he had tried was the one we ordered, and it was a great recommendation. However, the meat was undercooked.pecifically the pork. A friend of ours came earlier in the evening and had another ramen with the pork, and my partner had one with pork as well, and  both of them were sick shortly after. Our friend sent his back because of how undercooked it was. I ordered chicken, which I did not notice an issue with. 
The crepes are a surefire go-to. They have an enormous selection. It does take longer than I am used to waiting for a crepe, and I noticed again that the staff were super under prepared and didn't know what to do. It seemed to me the management here were more concerned with opening and not setting up their staff for success, which is disappointing. I'm glad it wasn't super busy so they could figure it out.
Overall, those new business issues are all there. I'l

Another delicious meal. This time we came after a show at 9:30 on a Saturday night. Tables were open. Steaks we perfect.
Back again for another delicious meal. 
We came back again in July 2020. 
Service was great and they were observing the COVID restrictions.
The meal was just ok. I had the NY Strip and it was very fatty. Even fat in the middle of the steak. Wasn't a good cut.
The Sea Bass special is ok. Needed some more flavor. 
We changed our review from 5 star to 3 star. 
Came in again during the COVID crisis. Tables were set up as every other.
My steak was not good. Real fatty. I am ok with a bit of fat on the outside. But my steak and fat in the middle. Was not a good cut.

Before the Covid came about. Me and my man first date. It was nice and quiet. Food was alright. It was not amazingly good. But not bad. The shrimp and hot tea was one of my staples. The steak was good not not bad. Great for price and size.
Food was good and the only reason I am leaving 4stars is the price of 1 pancake which was $5.19.

Wow what a great place. Vietnamese Spring rolls are really good and fresh. Tom Yum soup is a must and so is the Snapper in red curry sauce.
Good service and big portions and very reasonable prices.

Bruno's is a great place in the middle of a residential area and if you were lucky enough to live next to it I would be out there every single day. Friendly service and look like really good food although we only sampled the cheese fries which were outstanding. Lots of great Sports to watch and a huge screen TV on one end for a table of 8 to watch their favorite game. Nice people and a great environment down close to st-charles.

I went for their live music and carry out food.  The employees were so friendly even with the adverse conditions.  I was very impressed.  The drinks were great and the Mahi Tacos were amazing!!!!  I will definitely go back.

This is by far the WORST Waffle House I have ever been to. It was very obvious we weren't getting served because we are white. The floors are disgusting, food is being handled terribly. This place needs to be shut down ASAP. We will never be back. Shame on the managers of this place, y'all are doing terribly at your job. What a shame that my family can't even go eat breakfast because no one wanted to serve us here. Disgusting.

This place is absolutely amazing! After reading the reviews I was so excited to come here... and let me tell you, it did not disappoint! Some of the best ice cream I've ever had with so many different flavors to choose from. Do yourself a favor and give this shop a visit!!
Tacos were bangin!! The burrito was Huge as well as the enchiladas. The service was fast  the cashier was very polite I will definitely order from here again

Everything seems to be the same as the restaurant that was here before, except this one has chips and salsa instead of chicharrones.

Pretty much the same generic Americanized Mexican fare that most places serve. Same menu. Unfortunately the food lacked any flavor and heat. The chips and tortillas were stale to top it off. My beer glass is riddled with chipped glass which they probably inherited from the previous owners.

I wasn't excited about being sat next to the only other patrons in the restaurant and their screaming children. Pretty big let down which is probably why the place is dead only a month after opening and the Mexican restaurant a few blocks away is busy.

If they learned how to season their food I may come back.The enchiladas, tacos, and salsa were less seasoned than the Mexican food I had in Canada. Don't be afraid of the chiles!
Great food. Horrible service. You'll wait over 20 minutes for a few tenders. Fix this place please.. the chicken is too good

Old timey diner feel for some delicious comfort food. The wait on a Saturday morning was pretty quick around 9 and even when we left there didn't appear to be much of a wait. 

Eggs and potatoes are what they are, but the corned beef hash and biscuits were fantastic. Great start to the day and can't beat the value you'll find here for breakfast. 

The service was fast and super friendly, they added a second free biscuit to all of our orders and gave 2 free biscuits to the one member of my party who's order didn't already come with them!

Ordered my food at 530 pm through Grubhub finally after 90 minutes, my food was received. When I ordered it said it would only take 30-60 minutes, next time I need to order from Sushi Cafe, never any problems in the past with d

A bearded male employee used the ladies room and then returned to work without washing his hands (!) Yes, it's a competitive labor market but a big hell no on this one. We did tell the manager, no response.
Also coffee tases like raw acid spewed from the bowels of a Gila monster.

Excellent food, exceptional service. My friend just moved to the neighborhood and we went while I visited from out of town. We tried the sangria, potato wedges, jerk wings, pot pie, BLT salad and cheesecake (don't judge us LOL we couldn't choose so we sampled!) everything was delicious, all of our needs were met and we had no complaints. We even loved the cookie on the side of the cheesecake so much, we requested to buy a box of that to go and they obliged! Would highly recommend

This review is delayed but wanted to recommend to others,  the Wagyu steak and cream corn brûlée are delicious. Tasty and fresh oyster selection. My husband and I enjoyed a night out here very much. Seated promptly close to reservation time. We are nondrinkers and server was happy to get us Mojito mocktails. Some of the nicer steakhouses often get surly when we don't order an expensive bottle of wine, but not here. Highly recommend for special occasion or a romantic date night out on the town.
Delicious coffee, welcoming location, best in the West talented, brilliant, incredible, amazing, show stopping, spectacular, never the same, totally unique, completely not ever been done before.
Food is good service is brutal why is their no managers on the floor teen age girl controlling the flow of the restaurant u restaurant 101 gents

Loved the vibe of this place and the food was great! Our server was delightful and incredibly friendly. Would definitely return next time I'm in the area.
Was so thankful they had a tasty vegetarian option

Visiting town and was recommended this place after asking for local and organic food. Had a good immediate impression while walking up. Super sweet hostess. My server Sebastian was exceptionally friendly and personable and gave a great recommendation for the cheesy bruschetta. All patrons and employees looked happy. The the place is clean and comfortable. The owner delivered my main course and he seems like a super cool dude as well. Both appetizers and the entree I got were beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. I have nothing negative to say about this place. Would definitely recommend. Even their paper napkins are nifty and unique.

Great place for sushi  I thought I wasn't really a sushi person. But, after eating here. I want more. They have a great selection of sushi, along with other Asian cuisine. The lunch specials are good portions. You can select just from the regular sushi menu( which is a larger portion). The fish is fresh and very tasty. I really enjoyed my visit.

I have dined here quite a few times now and I must say with all the good experiences I've had, it's become one of my go-to restaurants down the block. This past weekend, my husband and I decided to come here for brunch. While you are currently unable to select outdoor seating when reserving a table (leading to a longer wait time on arrival), the staff is very friendly and accommodating. They not only seated us quickly but even met our request to be in the sun. The tables were at a good distance, staff wore appropriate PPE, and I felt comfortable (and safe) dining here from a COVID standpoint. The heaters between each table were definitely a plus and kept me warm. My husband and I shared the savory hush puppies, posh brunch with italian truffle eggs, and ricotta ravioli with pumpkin and parmesan sauce. Everything was seasoned perfectly and very flavorful. Similar to my prior dining experiences here, I asked my waitress to let the chef know how great the dishes were. I definitely highly recommend this restaurant and cannot wait to be back!

The food here was amazing. We had three different appetizers: Pork Cracklings, Boudin Balls, and Sweet Potato Beignets. Everything we ate was something unique that I had never tried before and was absolutely delicious. The interior was very cool and modern. It also had a nice jazz band playing live music while you're eating. Not sure if that's an all day thing or only on weekends, but either way it was a nice touch. The drinks were strong, but also delicious. I will definitely be back for happy hour!
Hands down the best food on the street.  We have tried the others, this one is so much better.  Great staff and excellent sangria.  Must stop on Dodecanese Street.
Great food, pasta was fresh and food came out quick. Staff was friendly and the place seemed pretty clean. Oh yeah and their margaritas are good!
Honestly it's probably right up there with my favorites. There's not many pizzas I've eaten whole without picking apart and this was definitely one of them. It was sooooo yummy!!

We have gotten delivery from these folks a few times. Each time we see the quality of the food and service decline. Last time we ordered rolls wrapped in rice paper in lieu of rice which costs an extra $2. They didn't pay attention to that and we got regular rolls. I called to tell them and they said they wouldn't charge my card the $2. When I explained we ordered it without rice for a reason and we could not eat it, they just said that's all they could do. We most likely will not be ordering from them anymore.

We went for our 37th wedding an anniversary, just the hibs and I. The service and food were great. We got the daily special of the fritters. They were crab n chorizo. They were very good but honestly I did not taste much chorizo. I also got the baked oysters......they were outstanding although I added a little salt 
For dinner hubs got the grouper sandwich with the yuca fries. He got the grouper grilled both were excellent. Probably the best yuca fries I've ever had. Their starter sauce was excellant, most restaurants I always doctor it up for my taste. This one was perfect. 
I got the fish tacos, which we boxed up to take home. They will be lunch tomorrow. With the Caribbean slaw......it was so good!!!!. 
We split a key line pie for desser, it was excellent. Made with condensed milk (I am not usually a fan of) but this one is excellent.  It had a meringue topping which was good but we prefer a fresh whip cream. Which they had on there to cover up gaps in the meringue.  The fresh whip cream topping would have been preferred. 
We will definitely go back!!!! I wish they were open for lunch!!! The prices we on par for the food and restaurant!!.

For the price point, this hotel delivers. Looking for a reasonably priced hotel in the gulch for a weekend, we decided to try this relatively new Fairfield Inn. We were pleased by the kindness and efficiency of the staff when we checked in and they problem solved well when we had an unusual circumstance that required some attention from the front desk. They were also very responsive when two of our three rooms needed the bathroom floor re-cleaned.

The rooms were small and basic but the bed was comfortable and the bathroom was functional. We didn't spend much time in our rooms so it was fine for us. One of the two mornings we ate at the complimentary breakfast buffet. I was surprised to exit the elevator and see one of the staff members slicing brisket. Brisket? At Fairfield Inn? Yes, brisket.  And it was delicious, flavorful, and tender. The rest of the buffet met our needs for a light breakfast.

We enjoyed our stay here and the location was great. It was a short walk or drive to restaurants in the Gulch and to downtown sites.

Food was just meh and the service was the same. Won't go back for a second chance. 

My husband ordered the ribs and a salad. The ribs came before the salad which is annoying. The salad came with the wrong dressing. The ribs were dry and over cooked. 

I got the burger of the week. It was a double patty burger with Brie and greens. It was supposed to be cooked medium. First it was one of the greasiest burgers I have eaten and It was almost rare. 

The waitress was attentive enough and brought the salad when it was missing and the dressing. The ambiance is loud. Live music on Wednesday and Saturday. This place was just not my bag.

Service was excellent. Pear bruschetta and Shrimp and grits were delicious. My friend and I split the apps and the Pork Osso bucco. Everything was so tasty! I felt full but not over stuffed. Ambience is cool. This might be a new fave for me
Chicken & waffles are . Musical performances regularly. Great place to eat and hang out.
Love this place! Great neighborhood spot! They always have daily specials. Been going here for over 8 years and we still love it every time! Friendly staff and dog friendly for outdoor seating.
Great Taiwanese and Shanghainese food and AMAZING service. This is our family's go-to place in Chinatown!
This place is delicious! The owners are super sweet, it's clean and quick. We bring our rambunctious almost 2 year old and we always feel welcome. The Greek salad is one of the best!

I love this place it's reasonably price and the food is always delicious! The people who work there are lovely and they always have a smile on their face in their happy to see me! I love this place and if you ever want Chinese food this is where you should go to have it! I eat here frequently and it's probably the only place lately that is consistently delicious. And by consistently I mean over the past eight years that I've been in this neighborhood.

Food here is always consistently good. 

I order from Zoe's whenever I want something healthy and fast. Their kabobs are great, as is their hummus. I used to love their chicken roll ups before I went gluten free too.

I don't love their cauliflower rice at all (it's tasteless!) or their falafel. 

I've been ordering on DoorDash mostly lately but when I go in, service is great and people are very friendly.

They also offer recyclable to-go boxes which is a great touch.
Keto options on point! Can't comment on the pizza for the obvious reasons :) But I would come back.

First, this place has never failed me as far as flavor. But my past experiences could  never parallel as far as service! This was my first time ever sitting at the bar and  OH. MY. GOD. I left feeling like they were my best friends.  Andrew came in later in our experience & truly stole the show! I also was a regular of Courtney's at her pre covid bar so to see her and be able to experience her sevice again just added to the perfection. 20 starts for ulele bartenders. I will be back!!
We were waiting for a table for 10 minutes,  finally they started cleaning a table for us some other customer just went and took our table with out asking anyone and staff didnt say a word to them.

We came here excited for a Sunday morning breakfast. It was freezing in the restaurant, there were lipstick stains on the water glasses, and hair stuck to the top of the Tabasco sauce. Disappointing all around.

Recently tried Teaspoon and it was absolutely delish. The bubble waffle was my favorite. Everything about it was perfect, the level of crispy was, the waffle flavor, the compote and the strawberries. We had lattes that were strong and good. My boyfriend had the breakfast pizza and I tried some too. It had a lot of flavor and was overall very tasty, my only complaint is that it's very heavy on the lettuce. We went early to try avoid crowds, by 9 it was pretty busy and everyone was trying to get a patio seat. I saw they allow dogs on the patio and bring the dogs water which is always a win.

An elementary school teacher asked me if she could sit on my face because I offered her my seat so she could watch a day old replay of a soccer game. 

Great drink specials almost every night!

Classic hole in the wall serving delicious Ethiopian food. I met my friend for lunch at Awash today. I love Ethiopian food but had never been to Awash before, and she had never tried Ethiopian food before and was curious to try it. I love that Awash doesn't have a menu. You walk in and are asked how many and meat or no meat. We were a party of two and asked for meat. A few minutes later, we were brought a lunch for two! Everything was delicious - the beef, the lentils, the cabbage, the greens...! We ate up all our injera, and we were immediately brought more. I overate because everything was delicious, and I didn't want to waste anything. It was $14 for each of us, and a generous amount of food for that amount. We were also brought two coffees, which livened us up after overeating the delicious food. The restaurant itself isn't much to look at - five tables and a small kitchen (it got a teensy bit smokey when she was cooking), and we did have to park at the gas station next door because there's very little parking here. But the service was great, and the food was even better! If you love Ethiopian food, check Awash out when you're in the area.

Me and my husband love this Carrabba's for drinks and dinner. It's always a great experience. Carl the bartender is super. He has our drinks waiting for us followed by their hot and fresh so delicious bread with yummy dipping oil & herbs. The stuffed mushrooms are excellent with a sauce that doesn't have a chance being sopped up by that bread. Dinner never disappoints. I love their pastas and hubby likes steaks or chicken dishes all sooo good. During this time they are extra clean and safe. I highly recommend this Carrabba's oh yea and love love love the mussels

Decent mexican food but honestly the service was so bad that I cannot give anything more than 3 stars in good faith. To be fair, they seemed quite understaffed and UNR move in day was that same week (it was packed), but as a wise man once told me, "Excuses are the nails that build failure". The guacamole needed way more lime, and their limes were slices instead of wedges which made it extremely hard to squeeze. Al pastor wet burrito was decent, and so were the carne asada tacos. Would have probably gave 3.5 stars with good service. It took us at least 15 minutes for our server to come to our table, and the entire night she seemed excessively impatient to anything we might have asked for.
Soooooo good!!! My husband and I are here from Wisconsin and wanted pizza and we stopped here and I am so happy we did! Everyone had great customer service and the pizza was perfect!!!

Food was made to order and delicious. We got the Chicago style dog and Mel's dog with fries. The fries were freshly fried which was tasty. They have high chairs for children and the tables were sanitized and wiped down after each use. We do love hotdogs so it was a nice treat since we stopped by on our way home from the Zoo. The hotdog wasn't the most filling but I will say we didn't get a hearty dog, we chose one of the lighter ones. My husband joked that we should come back and order 40 hotdogs. We will be back and enjoyed our experience.

From the excellent service to the great food IDK where to start with this hidden place inside of a hotel! A must go to if your in the downtown CBD area! I found the place on yelp but it need more recognition... IJS! My fave so far is the buffalo frog legs, and they redfish (sum10)! Just go check them out. You won't be disappointed!

We went hungry, we liked the nice clean facility and wait staff.  The Portobello mushrooms were amazingly flavorful and delicious.  The avocado bruschetta was not flavorful.  The Reuben was good, the jackfruit was not flavorful but my husband mixed it with the rice and beans and said it was much better.  The cheese cake alone was okay but then we mixed the two flavors and it was great.  We mixed mocha and pistachio.  The tea and meal was outrageously expensive but good.
The manager was walking around inside without a mask covering his face, the staff was rude, the food was overpriced and mediocre (at best), and the guacamole was some of the worst I've ever had.

Food was great--service so-so. Our server (I won't say their name or describe because I'm not looking into getting anyone in trouble, everybody can improve at their jobs to some degree)--seemed very out of it. There was 7 of us. They grabbed my friend a wine sample and then disappeared for moment before getting our drink order. We ordered appetizers and drinks. The drinks took a little too long to come out but I guess there was 7 of us and she could have had more tables. My friend had to ask 4 times for hot sauce. When another friend joined later--they ignored him after coming by twice to check on us. Then when checks came--the ziosk wasn't working--not a big deal. But the poor server could not seem to split the checks right and it took 30 minutes to get cashed out which just seems ridiculous. Also they never asked how our food was and didn't seem really engaged with us. 
At the end--the checks were never right and we just had to pass cash around to make up for it. I still tipped 20%+ because everyone has bad days. I'm hoping the managers can train their servers better and share this feedback to their team.
Love this sushi spot!!! Quick and delicious!!  And very friendly!!!  I highly recommend!!!

This place is your go to for breakfast when in Santa Barbara. The line is out the door for a reason! The menu is simple and the food is delicious. The service is great too. I highly recommend this venue.
Lived up to the billing. This place is so good and under rated in town . The tray of various cuts of meats is superb !!! Diners Drive Ins and Dives loves this place as much as  I do!!!

My boyfriend and I were starving so we decided to eat at this cafe before grocery shopping at Aldi across the street. It's a small, clean cafe, but there is tons of seating upstairs so don't be fooled. I ordered the house salad with chicken. Usually when chicken is served on top of salad at a cafe I have low expectations. I expect the flavor to be subpar and for the chicken to be dry. This chicken though? Honey it was hot, flavorful, and fresh! The salad also had candied walnuts and goat cheese--both of which managed to taste fresh as well. Honestly, I wondered while eating if they made the candied walnuts on site. I can't speak to the other items on the menu, but if they live up to the salad you won't be disappointed.

So we just went here for the first time. You drive up and place your order from the car. I ordered my husband a pizza and I ordered the Spaghetti MEAL. I ordered meatballs and mushrooms. Comes with crisp garlic bread. Sound amazing? Got home. My MEAL had NO Meatballs and NO garlic bread. I called them on the phone. Was given the Bum's Rush by a gal that said her Manager was too busy to come to the phone. This, after I put a 4 dollar tip on my debit card for him to walk 4 feet to my car. I guess they are too busy making money instead of making it RIGHT. The snarky gal on the phone said she would credit me one dollar. Sad since I won't be going back to collect it.

Just picked up my free meal, a Butcher Burger & Basket of Animal Style Fries, from Dino's  Thank you Anonymous East Nashville neighbor for your generosity, donating $1000 tab to all us service industry folks today due to the coronavirus pamdemic. This is why I love living in East Nashville. It's filled with yummy eateries like Dino's and kindhearted folks who care during times like these.

From the moment we first came to this establishment it's always been a positive experience- as well as tonight, when they greeted us and thanked us so much for coming in again so soon. Which is so incredibly nice that this company is so grateful for our loyalty. They're always changing the types of swirls and flavors which is nice it allows us to try something new every time... and like always it was so incredibly delicious...

This is my first review of this place, however this isn't my first time coming to this restaurant. The review I'll give will be brief but a combination of all my visits. I will describe the food for this specific visit. 
Maggie Maes is one of my brother's fav restaurants to go to. Great hospitality with regular guests and new guests. They always make you feel that you are part of the family. 
This restaurant is more known for their breakfast and lunch. Has a great range menu of traditional lunch items to burgers. My brother ordered the burger which looked great when it came out. I ordered the Lobster sandwich which also looked good. I was craving it so had to order it as the special. However, I felt that it lacked in taste and flavoring. It was really dry but the lobster meat was plentiful. 
Again, Maggie Mae's is a great place to visit and you will always be treated like family as long as you treat them the right way.

My first use of takeout drive up at Olive Garden. I Placed the order online yesterday received an email confirmation and was able to make payment and pay a tip. I received complete instructions on how to proceed this morning. I arrived about 10 minutes before my designated delivery time. I followed the instructions of pulling into the space calling in with the number and my order was ready to go. The young lady brought it to the car placed it in the car while wearing a mask. When we arrived home and the food was hot fresh and everything was delicious.

I'm so annoyed with myself for not coming to La Choza sooner. This restaurant is absolutely fantastic! I've been learning Spanish with a tutor for the past 2 months and am trying to immerse myself in the culture; food, music, books, etc. La Choza's menu is authentic for Latin cuisine with dishes from Mexico, Cuba, Puerto Rico, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia. 

I had the Shrimp Mofongo. It was exceptional! The lemon garlic sauce was light & heavenly! Shrimp were large and tail-off. I love plátanos! The mofongo was seasoned just right. Also had the Tostones (as if I didn't have enough plantains). They too were cooked perfectly: soft on the inside and crisp on the outside, seasoned with sea salt. I ate the entire order myself. 

My husband had the Burrito Deluxe, stuffed with shrimp and rib eye. It was HUGE; looked like Sky Lab. It was covered in melted white cheese which was most likely queso Chihuahua. Served with refried beans and rice. He loved it; didn't leave a grain of rice on his plate.

Inside is decorated nicely and appropriately. Soft Spanish music plays in the background. Service is outstanding and everyone is very friendly.  They didn't even mind when I practiced my Spanish :)

Masks required; social distancing enforced; staff wears masks; hand sanitizer available. Entire place is super clean.

We can't wait to go back.

First time ordering from here and boy was I surprised!  Delicious pizza and fast delivery time!  I must of drove past this place hundreds of times living here and always thought I'd like to try it.  Well I couldn't be happier!  Great job Pizzava I highly recommend and will order from here from now on!
I can't believe it took me this long to try the Hot Salami...and with roast beef on it...on garlic bread.  Just do it. You're welcome.

Stopped in to simply enjoy a cafe con leche and toasted, buttered bread for breakfast.  The staff was very friendly and the coffee and bread were very good.  Took some Cuban bread to go and also picked up some yummy flan.  Look forward to coming back for a meal next time we visit!

Staff is kind. They have to be with all of the issues you are going to face when arriving. 
1- There's nothing telling you they are here. It's a small food truck in the parking lot with no clear markings. 
2- parking is very difficult. There's few spots and you have to really k ow your car in order to get in and out of the spots. 
3- I placed my order and arrived 35 minutes later. I had to wait an additional 25 minutes after arrival. 
4- I cancelled my order after being told "a couple more minutes" 5 times.
Excellent service, excellent experience, and excellent food! Went in July for a party and they were able to accommodate us during Covid loved the happy hour drink specials!
